narr: A mid-level shortwave trough moved over Texas and combined with an abnormally moist airmass to generate thunderstorms. These storms were very efficient rain producers dropping locally heavy rain that led to flash flooding. There were also a few severe thunderstorms.
ev: Training of thunderstorms with intense rainfall rates produced a swath of 3-8 inches of rain across San Antonio. Several vehicles were swept off the Loop 410 access road into Beitel Creek. There were 11 fatalities in this creek and the surrounding area. Ten people were rescued from the water, and two others were able to get to safety on their own. Damage from the flooding totaled $23 million across Bexar County.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. RM 152 and RM 2323 were closed at some of the tributaries to the Llano River east and southeast of Castell.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. The Banta Branch of the Pedernales River was out of its banks southwest of Harper.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Bexarflood.org showed several low water crossings closed in northwestern Bexar County.

Training of thunderstorms with intense rainfall rates produced a swath of 3-8 inches of rain across San Antonio. A non-vehicle related fatality was reported near Wurzbach Pkwy and Salado Creek. The body was discovered on June 14th. The exact location of where this person went into the water is not known.

Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. The San Antonio Fire Department completed three high water rescues from some of 18 flooded low water crossings in northwest and north-central San Antonio.

Training of thunderstorms with intense rainfall rates produced a swath of 3-8 inches of rain in San Antonio. A vehicle was swept into Leon Creek near Callaghan Rd. and Hwy 90 and the driver died. The vehicle was discovered on June 14th.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Mud Creek overflowed near the Saddle Mountain subdivision in the Stone Oak area of San Antonio.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain leading to flash flooding. Olmos Creek overflowed in northern San Antonio.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain leading to flash flooding. The normally dry Walnut Branch overflowed northeast of McQueeney.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain leading to flash flooding. The Comal County Sheriff reported several low water crossings flooded.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain leading to flash flooding. A normally dry creek overflowed in Garden Ridge.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain leading to flash flooding. Bexarflood.org reported 29 low water crossings flooded in northern Bexar County.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain leading to flash flooding. Multiple low water crossings were reported closed around Wimberley.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain leading to flash flooding. There was a news report of nine homes flooded along Shin Oak Dr. in Live Oak.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. One of our broadcast partners showed a photo of cars submerged on the main lanes of southbound I-35 at FM 3009.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain leading to flash flooding. Cottonwood Creek flooded a low water crossing on Old Bastrop Hwy near Capistrano Dr.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain leading to flash flooding. York Creek overflowed closing York Creek Rd. west of Zorn.

Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. The occupants of a vehicle were rescued after they were swept off the road on CR 2615 near CR 372 in the vicinity of the Medina River north of Rio Medina.

Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. The occupants of a vehicle were rescued after they were swept off the road on CR 381 in the vicinity of San Geronimo Creek northeast of Rio Medina.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. There was a high water rescue on I-35 near the Windcrest Business Park along Walzem Creek.

Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. The Emergency Manager reported flooding along FM 2790 between the South Wind Subdivision and Luckey Rd. east of Lytle. There were multiple water rescues.
